The other open-callable money-out functions sweep to a fixed owner-set beneficiary and pay the caller nothing: IGP.claim() / claimToken(address) (beneficiary 0xa7eccdb9be08178f896c26b7bbd8c3d4e844d9ba, an EOA, eth_getCode 0x) and ProtocolFee.collectProtocolFees() (0xa1af5b9a). Both claim() and collectProtocolFees() return 0x from eth_call of a fresh address (role-open). Rest is onlyOwner (setBeneficiary, setDefaultIsm/Hook/RequiredHook, setDestinationGasConfigs, add/removeQuoteSigner) or payer/view (dispatch, payForGas, quoteDispatch, quoteGasPayment).
